verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can find, evaluate, and plug in third-party MCP servers directly within Agentforce Builder via AgentExchange, and the Sales Cloud pricing page lists AgentExchange access, so Sales Cloud agents can consume external MCP tools. The support is one marketing-level mention, delivered through the Agentforce layer rather than Sales Cloud itself. The official salesforcecli/mcp server is server-side and is not credited here. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring and authenticating MCP server connections, clarity on which Sales Cloud editions or add-ons are required, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually invoke MCP tools.
